input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (background #060913), with glassmorphism HUD, zero external dependencies.
constraints: Single file index.html; all CSS and JS inline; no external scripts, fonts, images or network requests.
Page background and canvas clear color #060913; body margin 0, overflow hidden.

One full-window <canvas id="sim"> sized to window.innerWidth x innerHeight in CSS pixels, backing store scaled by window.devicePixelRatio (canvas.width = innerWidth*dpr, ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)); re-sized on window resize.
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame with dt in seconds (clamped to max 0.05).
Central star at canvas center drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient (white core -> #ffd27a -> #ff9a3c -> transparent), plus a corona whose radius/alpha pulses subtly with Math.sin of time.
At least 5 planets in window.app.planets, each with distinct orbit radius, angular speed and color (e.g. #4fc3f7, #ef5350, #66bb6a, #ffca28, #ab47bc, #26c6da); draw faint orbit path circles.
At least 3 moons total in window.app.moons, each orbiting a parent planet.
Each planet keeps a trail array of recent positions drawn as a fading polyline (alpha decreasing toward the oldest point); trails are hidden and cleared when trails are OFF.
Background starfield of at least 150 stars in window.app.stars, each twinkling (alpha varies with sin of time and per-star phase).

HUD: fixed-position glassmorphism panel top-left: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 14px, light text #e6ecff, system-ui font.
HUD button id="btnPlay" toggles play/pause; label text 'Pause' while running and 'Play' while paused.
HUD button id="btnTrails" toggles trails; label 'Trails: ON' / 'Trails: OFF'.
HUD button id="btnReset" resets simulation time to 0, planet/moon angles to initial values, clears trails and burst particles.

Speed slider exactly <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">, with readout span id="speedVal" showing e.g. '1.0x' updated live on input; window.app.speed holds the numeric value.
Live stats: span id="fps" (frames per second, integer), span id="simTime" (simulation time in seconds, 1 decimal, e.g. '12.3 s'), span id="particleCount" (active burst particle count integer).
Simulation time advances only while playing, by dt*speed; window.app.simTime holds it in seconds.

Clicking (pointerdown/click) on the canvas spawns a radial burst of 60-120 glowing particles at the click point into window.app.particles; each has velocity in random radial direction, velocity damping each frame (e.g. multiply by 0.96 per 1/60s), and life that fades alpha to 0, removed when dead. Draw with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter'.
Expose window.app = { planets, moons, stars, particles, playing, trails, speed, simTime, spawnBurst(x,y), reset() }; playing and trails are booleans kept in sync with the buttons.
Valid JavaScript, no console errors.

def run(ws_root: str | Path, spec: dict[str, Any], timeout_s: float = 45.0, perf: str = "fail",
        info: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """Run Chromium probe against the workspace entry point. Returns (exit_code, concise_report).
    perf 'fail': a frame rate under min_fps() fails the check; 'warn': it is only reported. info, when given,
    receives the frame rate data and perf_failed (the frame rate failed the check)."""
    root = Path(ws_root).resolve()
    entry = _resolve_entry(root, spec)
    if not entry:
        wanted = spec.get("preferred_entry") or "index.html"
        return 1, f"FAIL: missing web entry point {wanted!r} in workspace."

    require_anim = bool(spec.get("require_animation"))
    if not require_anim:
        html_txt = (root / entry).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        if "<canvas" in html_txt.lower() and "requestanimationframe" in html_txt.lower():
            require_anim = True

    node_bin = shutil.which("node")
    chrome_bin = find_chromium()

I created `index.html`. It's a single self-contained file with no external dependencies, and the JavaScript passes a syntax check.

Tandem's local model wrote the page but reported FAILED twice, without saying which check failed. Running the browser test myself showed 19 of 20 steps pass. The one failure was a mistake in my own test: the browser reports the slider's value `1.0` as `"1"`, so my exact-string comparison could never succeed. The actual HTML is correct: `<input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">`.

The steps that passed confirm:
- **Display:** the dark `#060913` background and a full-window canvas sized for the screen's pixel density.
- **Scene:** at least 5 planets, 3 moons and 150 stars, with the animation running.
- **Clicks:** clicking spawns burst particles, and the HUD counts them.
- **Controls:** Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF and the speed slider (with its `2.5x` readout) work; Reset clears time and particles; FPS shows live.

The star's glow, corona pulse, fading trails and twinkling stars are in the code but weren't individually tested.
